coreLoop: Perform a simple repeatable action to collect resources or income and immediately see production, inventory, or power increase.
Spend earned resources on upgrades, automation, helpers, or new production nodes that make the next earning cycle faster or strategically different.
Unlock a new area, tier, collection target, or prestige layer, then repeat the earning loop with a larger goal and visible long-term progression.
